description.narrative: Jeliv Consulting B.V. (Jeliv) is a consulting firm offering IT services to its clients in The Netherlands, Europe, and the globe a large. Its mission is to “assist costumers unlock their business insights through big data and analytics”. Jeliv helps companies and organizations setup their end-to-end data and analytics platforms by designing and deploying cloud infrastructure, building data engineering pipelines, constructing machine learning and deep learning models (AI) as well as creating visual dashboards. Jeliv assists its clients unlock their data analytic potentials in several areas including cloud computing, data engineering, data science and business analytics. Its clients are all companies and organizations requiring data solutions. Jeliv delivers its services through its employees or in partnership with other companies (freelancers).As a business model, Jeliv intends to create a center of excellence (CoE) through which readymade human capital will be recruited, trained, and utilized to serve its local and global clients thereby generating more revenue to the BV. Jeliv as a services company shall generate revenue by billing its clients at an hourly rate per person (consultant) per category in local currency of the client through invoices. For instance, South African clients shall be billed in Rands while European clients shall be billed in Euros. To fully establish in the region, Jeliv is considering short-term and long-term approaches.
